# install matrix
```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("Matrix")
```

# Load essential packages
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
```
# Read the CSV: make sure gene names are rownames
```{r}
raw <- read.csv("SCRHBF041.csv", row.names = 1)
```
# Confirm gene names are in rownames
```{r}
head(rownames(raw))    # Should look like: "GCLC", "CYP51A1", etc.
head(colnames(raw))    # Should look like: barcodes or random IDs
```
# Make sure it's a matrix
```{r}
raw <- as.matrix(raw)
```
# Check that rownames are present and look like barcodes
```{r}
head(rownames(raw))
```
# Check colnames
```{r}
head(colnames(raw)) 
```
# Transpose the data
```{r}
raw <- t(raw)
```
# Convert to matrix
```{r}
raw <- as.matrix(raw)
```
# Now these should be true:
```{r}
head(rownames(raw))   # Expect: barcodes (cells)
head(colnames(raw))   # Expect: gene names
```
# 3. Create Seurat object
```{r}
seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = raw, min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
```
# 4. Add mitochondrial percentage (optional, if human genes and you use MT- prefix)
```{r}
seurat_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, pattern = "^MT-")
```
# 5. Quality control plots
```{r}
VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
```
# Skip percent.mt filtering since values are all 0

# Filter based on nFeature_RNA and nCount_RNA
```{r}
seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, 
                     subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & 
                              nFeature_RNA < 2500 & 
                              nCount_RNA < 50000)
```
# Violin plots for QC metrics after filtering
```{r}
VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
```
# Normalize
```{r}
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
```
# Find variable features
```{r}
seurat_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
```
# View  top 10 variable genes
```{r}
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(seurat_obj), 10)
print(top10)
```
# plot top 10 variable features with proper gene labels
```{r}
plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(seurat_obj)
plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
plot2
```


# Verify gene names
```{r}
head(colnames(seurat_obj))
```
# Check the raw matrix
```{r}
raw_df <- read.csv("SCRHBF041.csv", row.names = 1)
print(head(colnames(raw_df), 20))  # Show first 20 column headers
```
